sentences.zh: 」侯景小字狗子，初自懸瓠來降，懸瓠則古之汝南也。

translations.literal: " Hou Jing's childhood name was Gouzi; he first came to surrender from Xuanhuo—ancient Ruyin.
translations.idiomatic: " Hou Jing's childhood name was Gouzi; he first came to surrender from Xuanhuo—ancient Ruyin.

sentences.zh: 巴陵南有地名三湘，即景奔敗之所。

translations.literal: South of Baling is a place called Sanxiang—where Jing fled in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: South of Baling is a place called Sanxiang—where Jing fled in defeat.

sentences.zh: 天監中，茅山隱士陶弘景為五言詩曰：「夷甫任散誕，平叔坐談空，不意昭陽殿，忽作單于宮。

translations.literal: During Tianjian, the hermit Tao Hongjing of Mount Mao composed a five-character poem saying: "Yang Xiu indulged in dissipation; He Yan sat discussing emptiness—who expected Zhaoyang Hall would suddenly become the Xiongnu palace?
translations.idiomatic: During Tianjian, the hermit Tao Hongjing of Mount Mao composed a five-character poem saying: "Yang Xiu indulged in dissipation; He Yan sat discussing emptiness—who expected Zhaoyang Hall would suddenly become the Xiongnu palace?

sentences.zh: 」及大同之季，公卿唯以談玄為務。

translations.literal: " By the end of Datong, public officials devoted themselves solely to discussing the abstruse.
translations.idiomatic: " By the end of Datong, public officials devoted themselves solely to discussing the abstrue.

sentences.zh: 夷甫、平叔，朝賢也。

translations.literal: Yang Xiu and He Yan were court worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xiu and He Yan were court worthies.

sentences.zh: 侯景作亂，遂居昭陽殿。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing rebelled, he occupied Zhaoyang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing rebelled, he occupied Zhaoyang Hall.

sentences.zh: 大同中，童謠曰：「青絲白馬壽陽來。

translations.literal: During Datong, a children's song said: "Green silk, white horse—Shouyang comes.
translations.idiomatic: During Datong, a children's song said: "Green silk, white horse—Shouyang comes.

sentences.zh: 」其後侯景破丹陽，乘白馬，以青絲為羈勒。

translations.literal: " Afterward Hou Jing broke Danyang, rode a white horse, and used green silk for the bridle.
translations.idiomatic: " Afterward Hou Jing broke Danyang, rode a white horse, and used green silk for the bridle.

sentences.zh: 陳初，有童謠曰：「黃班青驄馬，發自壽陽涘。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chen, a children's song said: "Yellow Ban, green piebald horse—setting out from Shouyang's shore.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chen, a children's song said: "Yellow Ban, green piebald horse—setting out from Shouyang's shore.

sentences.zh: 來時冬氣末，去日春風始。

translations.literal: Coming at winter's end; departing at spring's beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Coming at winter's end; departing at spring's beginning.

sentences.zh: 」其後陳主果為韓擒所敗。

translations.literal: " Afterward Chen Houzhu was indeed defeated by Han Qin.
translations.idiomatic: " Afterward Chen Houzhu was indeed defeated by Han Qin.

sentences.zh: 擒本名擒虎，黃班之謂也。

translations.literal: Qin's original name was Qinhu—this is what "Yellow Ban" means.
translations.idiomatic: Qin's original name was Qinhu—this is what "Yellow Ban" means.

sentences.zh: 破建康之始，複乘青驄馬，往反時節皆相應。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the capture of Jiankang he again rode a green piebald horse; the seasons of coming and going all corresponded.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the capture of Jiankang he again rode a green piebald horse; the seasons of coming and going all corresponded.

sentences.zh: 陳時，江南盛歌王獻之《桃葉》之詞曰：「桃葉複桃葉，渡江不用楫。

translations.literal: In Chen times, south of the Yangtze widely sang Wang Xianzhi's "Peach Leaf" lyrics: "Peach leaf upon peach leaf—cross the river without oars.
translations.idiomatic: In Chen times, south of the Yangtze widely sang Wang Xianzhi's "Peach Leaf" lyrics: "Peach leaf upon peach leaf—cross the river without oars.

sentences.zh: 但度無所苦，我自迎接汝。

translations.literal: Just cross without hardship—I myself will come to meet you.
translations.idiomatic: Just cross without hardship—I myself will come to meet you.

sentences.zh: 」晉王伐陳之始，置營桃葉山下，及韓擒渡江，大將任蠻奴至新林以導北軍之應。

translations.literal: " When Prince Jin campaigned against Chen, he set camp at Peach Leaf Mountain; when Han Qin crossed the river, the great general Ren Mannu reached Xinlin to guide the northern army—this was the response.
translations.idiomatic: " When Prince Jin campaigned against Chen, he set camp at Peach Leaf Mountain; when Han Qin crossed the river, the great general Ren Mannu reached Xinlin to guide the northern army—this was the corresponding omen.

sentences.zh: 陳後主造齊雲觀，國人歌之曰：「齊雲觀，寇來無際畔。

translations.literal: Chen Houzhu built the Qiyun Observatory; the people sang: "Qiyun Observatory—when bandits come there is no boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Houzhu built the Qiyun Observatory; the people sang: "Qiyun Observatory—when bandits come there is no boundary.

sentences.zh: 」功未畢，而為隋師所虜。

translations.literal: " Before the work was finished he was captured by Sui troops.
translations.idiomatic: " Before the work was finished he was captured by Sui troops.

sentences.zh: 禎明初，後主作新歌，詞甚哀怨，令後宮美人習而歌之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenming, Houzhu composed a new song with very plaintive lyrics and ordered palace beauties to learn and sing it.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhenming, Houzhu composed a new song with very plaintive lyrics and ordered palace beauties to learn and sing it.

sentences.zh: 其辭曰：「玉樹後庭花，花開不復久。

translations.literal: The lyrics say: "Jade Tree flowers in the Rear Court—the blossoms will not last long.
translations.idiomatic: The lyrics say: "Jade Tree flowers in the Rear Court—the blossoms will not last long.

sentences.zh: 」時人以歌讖，此其不久兆也。

translations.literal: " People of the time took the song as an omen—this was the portent that the state would not endure.
translations.idiomatic: " People of the time took the song as an omen—this was the portent that the state would not endure.

sentences.zh: 齊神武始移都于鄴，時有童謠雲：「可憐青雀子，飛入鄴城裡。

translations.literal: When Qi Shenwu first moved the capital to Ye, a children's song said: "Pitiable green sparrow fledgling, flying into Ye city.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi Shenwu first moved the capital to Ye, a children's song said: "Pitiable green sparrow fledgling, flying into Ye city.

sentences.zh: 作窠猶未成，舉頭失鄉里。

translations.literal: Building a nest not yet finished, raising its head it loses its homeland.
translations.idiomatic: Building a nest not yet finished, raising its head it loses its homeland.

sentences.zh: 寄書與婦母，好看新婦子。

translations.literal: Send word to the bride's mother—take good care of the new bride.
translations.idiomatic: Send word to the bride's mother—take good care of the new bride.

sentences.zh: 」魏孝靜帝者，清河王之子也。

translations.literal: " Emperor Xiaojing of Wei was the son of the Prince of Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: " Emperor Xiaojing of Wei was the son of the Prince of Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 後則神武之女。

translations.literal: The empress afterward was Shenwu's daughter.
translations.idiomatic: The empress afterward was Shenwu's daughter.

sentences.zh: 鄴都宮室未備，即逢禪代，作窠未成之效也。

translations.literal: Ye's palaces were not yet complete when the abdication came—the effect of the nest not yet finished.
translations.idiomatic: Ye's palaces were not yet complete when the abdication came—the effect of the nest not yet finished.

sentences.zh: 孝靜尋崩，文宣以後為太原長公主，降于楊愔。

translations.literal: Xiaojing soon died; Wenxuan made the former empress Princess Chang of Taiyuan and married her to Yang Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaojing soon died; Wenxuan made the former empress Princess Chang of Taiyuan and married her to Yang Yin.

sentences.zh: 時婁後尚在，故言寄書於婦母。

translations.literal: At that time Empress Lou was still alive—therefore it says send word to the bride's mother.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Empress Lou was still alive—therefore it says send word to the bride's mother.

sentences.zh: 新婦子，斥後也。

translations.literal: "New bride" means the empress.
translations.idiomatic: "New bride" means the empress.

sentences.zh: 武定中，有童謠雲：「百尺高竿摧折，水底燃燈澄滅。

translations.literal: During Wuding, a children's song said: "A hundred-foot pole snaps; the lamp burning underwater, Cheng is extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: During Wuding, a children's song said: "A hundred-foot pole snaps; the lamp burning underwater, Cheng is extinguished.

sentences.zh: 」高者，齊姓也。

translations.literal: " Gao means the Qi surname.
translations.idiomatic: " Gao means the Qi surname.

sentences.zh: 澄，文襄名。

translations.literal: Cheng is Wenxiang's personal name.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng is Wenxiang's personal name.

sentences.zh: 五年，神武崩，摧折之應。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Shenwu died—the response to the pole snapping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Shenwu died—the omen corresponding to the pole snapping.

sentences.zh: 七年，文襄遇盜所害，澄滅之徵也。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Wenxiang was killed by bandits—the sign of Cheng's extinction.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Wenxiang was killed by bandits—the sign of Cheng's extinction.

sentences.zh: 天保中，陸法和入國，書其屋壁曰：「十年天子為尚可，百日天子急如火，周年天子反覆運算坐。

translations.literal: During Tianbao, Lu Fahe entered the state and wrote on his wall: "Ten years as Son of Heaven is still acceptable; a hundred days as Son of Heaven burns like fire; a full year as Son of Heaven sits turning calculations over and over.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianbao, Lu Fahe entered the state and wrote on his wall: "Ten years as Son of Heaven is still acceptable; a hundred days as Son of Heaven burns like fire; a full year as Son of Heaven sits turning calculations over and over.

sentences.zh: 」時文宣帝享國十年而崩。

translations.literal: " At that time Emperor Wenxuan held the realm ten years and died.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time Emperor Wenxuan held the realm ten years and died.

sentences.zh: 廢帝嗣立百餘日，用替厥位，孝昭即位一年而崩。

translations.literal: Deposed Emperor succeeded for more than a hundred days and was replaced; Emperor Xiaozhao succeeded and died within a year.
translations.idiomatic: Deposed Emperor succeeded for more than a hundred days and was replaced; Emperor Xiaozhao succeeded and died within a year.

sentences.zh: 此其效也。

translations.literal: This was the effect.
translations.idiomatic: This was the effect.

sentences.zh: ，童謠曰：「狐截尾，你欲除我我除你。

translations.literal: A children's song said: "Fox with tail cut short—you want to remove me, I remove you.
translations.idiomatic: A children's song said: "Fox with tail cut short—you want to remove me, I remove you.

sentences.zh: 」其年四月，隴東王胡長仁謀遣刺客殺和士開，事露，返為士開所譖死。

translations.literal: " That year in the fourth month, Prince Longdong Wang Hu Changren plotted to send assassins to kill He Shikai; the matter was exposed and he was slandered to death by Shikai in return.
translations.idiomatic: " That year in the fourth month, Prince Longdong Wang Hu Changren plotted to send assassins to kill He Shikai; the matter was exposed and he was slandered to death by Shikai in return.

sentences.zh: 二年，童謠曰：「和士開，七月三十日，將你向南台。

translations.literal: In the second year, a children's song said: "He Shikai—on the thirtieth day of the seventh month, they will take you to the Southern Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, a children's song said: "He Shikai—on the thirtieth day of the seventh month, they will take you to the Southern Terrace.

sentences.zh: 」小兒唱訖，一時拍手雲：「殺卻。

translations.literal: " When the children finished singing, everyone at once clapped their hands and shouted: "Kill him!
translations.idiomatic: " When the children finished singing, everyone at once clapped their hands and shouted: "Kill him!"

sentences.zh: 」至七月二十五日，御史中丞、琅邪王儼執士開，送于南台而斬之。

translations.literal: " On the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month, Imperial Censor Prince Langye Wang Yan seized Shikai, sent him to the Southern Terrace, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: " On the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month, Imperial Censor Prince Langye Wang Yan seized Shikai, sent him to the Southern Terrace, and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，又有童謠曰：「七月刈禾傷早，九月吃糕正好。

translations.literal: That year there was also a children's song saying: "In the seventh month the early harvest is harmed; in the ninth month eating cakes is just right.
translations.idiomatic: That year there was also a children's song saying: "In the seventh month the early harvest is harmed; in the ninth month eating cakes is just right.

sentences.zh: 十月洗蕩飯甕，十一月出卻趙老。

translations.literal: In the tenth month wash the rice pot clean; in the eleventh month drive out Old Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month wash the rice pot clean; in the eleventh month drive out Old Zhao.

sentences.zh: 」七月士開被誅，九月琅邪王遇害，十一月趙彥深出為西兗州刺史。

translations.literal: " In the seventh month Shikai was executed; in the ninth month Prince Langye was killed; in the eleventh month Zhao Yanshen was sent out as Inspector of Western Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: " In the seventh month Shikai was executed; in the ninth month Prince Langye was killed; in the eleventh month Zhao Yanshen was sent out as Inspector of Western Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 武平末，童謠曰：「黃花勢欲落，清樽但滿酌。

translations.literal: At the end of Wuping, a children's song said: "Yellow Flower's power is about to fall—just fill the clear cup.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Wuping, a children's song said: "Yellow Flower's power is about to fall—just fill the clear cup.

sentences.zh: 」時穆後母子淫僻，干預朝政，時人患之。

translations.literal: " At that time Empress Mu and her son were licentious and perverse, intervening in court affairs; people of the time resented this.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time Empress Mu and her son were licentious and perverse, intervening in court affairs; people of the time resented this.

sentences.zh: 穆後小字黃花，尋逢齊亡，欲落之應也。

translations.literal: Empress Mu's childhood name was Yellow Flower; soon afterward Qi was destroyed—the response to "about to fall."
translations.idiomatic: Empress Mu's childhood name was Yellow Flower; soon afterward Qi was destroyed—the omen corresponding to "about to fall."

sentences.zh: 鄴中又有童謠曰：「金作掃帚玉作把，淨掃殿屋迎西家。

translations.literal: In Ye there was also a children's song saying: "Gold for the broom handle, jade for the grip—sweep the palace clean to welcome the Western family.
translations.idiomatic: In Ye there was also a children's song saying: "Gold for the broom handle, jade for the grip—sweep the palace clean to welcome the Western family.

sentences.zh: 」未幾，周師入鄴。

translations.literal: " Before long Zhou troops entered Ye.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long Zhou troops entered Ye.

sentences.zh: 周初有童謠曰：「白楊樹頭金雞鳴，只有阿舅無外甥。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhou, a children's song said: "On the white poplar tree a golden rooster crows—only maternal uncles, no nephews.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhou, a children's song said: "On the white poplar tree a golden rooster crows—only maternal uncles, no nephews.

sentences.zh: 」靜帝隋氏之甥，既遜位而崩，諸舅強盛。

translations.literal: " Emperor Jing was the Sui clan's nephew; after abdicating he died; the maternal uncles were powerful.
translations.idiomatic: " Emperor Jing was the Sui clan's nephew; after abdicating he died; the maternal uncles were powerful.

sentences.zh: 周宣帝與宮人夜中連臂蹋蹀而歌曰：「自知身命促，把燭夜行遊。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuan of Zhou linked arms with palace women at night, treading and singing: "Knowing my life is short, I take a candle and wander by night.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan of Zhou linked arms with palace women at night, treading and singing: "Knowing my life is short, I take a candle and wander by night.

sentences.zh: 」帝即位三年而崩。

translations.literal: " The emperor died three years after ascending the throne.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor died three years after ascending the throne.

sentences.zh: ，高祖幸并州，宴秦孝王及王子相。

translations.literal: The High Emperor visited Bing Province and feasted Prince Qin Xiaowang and Prince Zixiang.
translations.idiomatic: The High Emperor visited Bing Province and feasted Prince Qin Xiaowang and Prince Zixiang.

sentences.zh: 帝為四言詩曰：「紅顏詎幾，玉貌須臾。

translations.literal: The emperor composed a four-character poem saying: "How long does rosy countenance last? Jade beauty lasts but a moment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor composed a four-character poem saying: "How long does rosy countenance last? Jade beauty lasts but a moment.

sentences.zh: 一朝花落，白發難除。

translations.literal: Once flowers fall, white hair is hard to remove.
translations.idiomatic: Once flowers fall, white hair is hard to remove.

sentences.zh: 明年後歲，誰有誰無。

translations.literal: Next year and the year after—who will remain and who will not?
translations.idiomatic: Next year and the year after—who will remain and who will not?"

sentences.zh: 」明年而子相卒，十八年而秦孝王薨。

translations.literal: " The next year Zixiang died; eighteen years later Prince Qin Xiaowang passed away.
translations.idiomatic: " The next year Zixiang died; eighteen years later Prince Qin Xiaowang passed away.

sentences.zh: ，煬帝自京師如東都，至長樂宮，飲酒大醉，因賦五言詩。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang traveled from the capital to the Eastern Capital; at Changle Palace he drank until greatly drunk and composed a five-character poem.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang traveled from the capital to the Eastern Capital; at Changle Palace he drank until greatly drunk and composed a five-character poem.

sentences.zh: 其卒章曰：「徒有歸飛心，無複因風力」。

translations.literal: The final stanza says: "I only have the heart to return home, but no longer have the wind's power to carry me."
translations.idiomatic: The final stanza says: "I only have the heart to return home, but no longer have the wind's power to carry me."

sentences.zh: 令美人再三吟詠，帝泣下沾襟，侍御者莫不欷歔。

translations.literal: He ordered the beauties to chant it again and again; the emperor wept until his collar was wet; those attending all sighed and sobbed.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the beauties to chant it again and again; the emperor wept until his collar was wet; those attending all sighed and sobbed.

sentences.zh: 帝因幸江都，複作五言詩曰：「求歸不得去，真成遭個春。

translations.literal: The emperor then went to Jiangdu and again composed a five-character poem saying: "Seeking to return but unable to leave—I truly meet this spring.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then went to Jiangdu and again composed a five-character poem saying: "Seeking to return but unable to leave—I truly meet this spring.

sentences.zh: 鳥聲爭勸酒，梅花笑殺人。

translations.literal: Birdsong all urges me to drink; plum blossoms laugh me to death.
translations.idiomatic: Birdsong all urges me to drink; plum blossoms laugh me to death.

sentences.zh: 」帝以三月被弑，即遭春之應也。

translations.literal: " The emperor was assassinated in the third month—the response to meeting spring.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor was assassinated in the third month—the omen corresponding to meeting spring.

sentences.zh: 是年盜賊蜂起，道路隔絕，帝懼，遂無還心。

translations.literal: That year bandits rose like bees; roads were cut off; the emperor was afraid and thus had no heart to return.
translations.idiomatic: That year bandits rose like bees; roads were cut off; the emperor was afraid and thus had no heart to return.

sentences.zh: 帝複夢二豎子歌曰：「住亦死，去亦死。

translations.literal: The emperor again dreamed of two boys singing: "Stay and you die; go and you die.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again dreamed of two boys singing: "Stay and you die; go and you die.

sentences.zh: 未若乘船渡江水。

translations.literal: Better to take a boat and cross the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Better to take a boat and cross the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 」由是築宮丹陽，將居焉。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he built a palace at Danyang, intending to dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he built a palace at Danyang, intending to dwell there.

sentences.zh: 功未就而帝被殺。

translations.literal: Before the work was finished the emperor was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Before the work was finished the emperor was killed.

sentences.zh: 大業中，童謠曰：「桃李子，鴻鵠繞陽山，宛轉花林裡。

translations.literal: During Daye, a children's song said: "Peach, plum, son—swans circle Yang Mountain, winding through the flower grove.
translations.idiomatic: During Daye, a children's song said: "Peach, plum, son—swans circle Yang Mountain, winding through the flower grove.

sentences.zh: 莫浪語，誰道許。

translations.literal: Do not speak rashly—who says Xu?
translations.idiomatic: Do not speak rashly—who says Xu?

sentences.zh: 」其後李密坐楊玄感之逆，為吏所拘，在路逃叛。

translations.literal: " Afterward Li Mi was implicated in Yang Xuangan's rebellion, was detained by officials, and escaped on the road.
translations.idiomatic: " Afterward Li Mi was implicated in Yang Xuangan's rebellion, was detained by officials, and escaped on the road.

sentences.zh: 潛結群盜，自陽城山而來，襲破洛口倉，後複屯兵苑內。

translations.literal: He secretly gathered bandits, came from Yangcheng Mountain, stormed and captured Luokou Granary, and afterward encamped within the imperial park.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly gathered bandits, came from Yangcheng Mountain, stormed and captured Luokou Granary, and afterward encamped within the imperial park.

sentences.zh: 莫浪語，密也。

translations.literal: "Do not speak rashly"—Mi.
translations.idiomatic: "Do not speak rashly"—Mi.

sentences.zh: 宇文化及自號許國，尋亦破滅。

translations.literal: Yuwen Huaji styled himself King of Xu and was soon destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Huaji styled himself King of Xu and was soon destroyed.

sentences.zh: 誰道許者，蓋驚疑之辭也。

translations.literal: "Who says Xu" is language of alarm and doubt.
translations.idiomatic: "Who says Xu" is language of alarm and doubt.

sentences.zh: ○毛蟲之孽

translations.literal: ○ Insect portents
translations.idiomatic: ○ Insect portents

sentences.zh: 梁武帝，邵陵王綸在南徐州臥內，方晝，有狸鬥於櫩上，墮而獲之。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Wu of Liang, Prince Shaoling Wang Lun was in his bedchamber at Southern Xuzhou; in broad daylight raccoon dogs fought on the eaves, fell, and were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Wu of Liang, Prince Shaoling Wang Lun was in his bedchamber at Southern Xuzhou; in broad daylight raccoon dogs fought on the eaves, fell, and were captured.

sentences.zh: 太清中，遇侯景之亂，將兵援台城。

translations.literal: During Taiqing he encountered the rebellion of Hou Jing and led troops to rescue Taicheng.
translations.idiomatic: During Taiqing he encountered the rebellion of Hou Jing and led troops to rescue Taicheng.

sentences.zh: 至鐘山，有蟄熊無何至，齧綸所乘馬。

translations.literal: At Zhongshan a hibernating bear suddenly appeared and bit the horse Lun rode.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhongshan a hibernating bear suddenly appeared and bit the horse Lun rode.

sentences.zh: 毛蟲之孽也。

translations.literal: This was an insect portent.
translations.idiomatic: This was an insect portent.

sentences.zh: 綸尋為王僧辯所敗，亡至南陽，為西魏所殺。

translations.literal: Lun was soon defeated by Wang Sengbian, fled to Nanyang, and was killed by Western Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Lun was soon defeated by Wang Sengbian, fled to Nanyang, and was killed by Western Wei.

sentences.zh: 中大同中，每夜狐鳴闕下，數年乃止。

translations.literal: During Zhongdatong, foxes cried nightly below the palace gate; after several years this ceased.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhongdatong, foxes cried nightly below the palace gate; after several years this ceased.

sentences.zh: 京房《易飛候》曰：「野獸群鳴，邑中且空虛。

translations.literal: Jing Fang's Flying Omens of the Changes says: "When wild beasts cry in groups, the settlement will soon be empty.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang's Flying Omens of the Changes says: "When wild beasts cry in groups, the settlement will soon be empty.

sentences.zh: 」俄而國亂，丹陽死喪略盡。

translations.literal: " Soon the state fell into chaos; death and mourning in Danyang were nearly complete.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon the state fell into chaos; death and mourning in Danyang were nearly complete.

sentences.zh: 陳禎明初，狐入床下，捕之不獲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenming in Chen, a fox entered beneath the bed and could not be captured.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhenming in Chen, a fox entered beneath the bed and could not be captured.

sentences.zh: 京房《易飛候》曰：「狐入君室，室不居。

translations.literal: Jing Fang's Flying Omens of the Changes says: "When a fox enters the ruler's chamber, the chamber will not be inhabited.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang's Flying Omens of the Changes says: "When a fox enters the ruler's chamber, the chamber will not be inhabited.

sentences.zh: 」未幾而國滅。

translations.literal: " Before long the state was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long the state was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 東魏武定三年九月，豹入鄴城南門，格殺之。

translations.literal: In Eastern Wei, ninth month of the third year of Wuding, a leopard entered Ye's southern gate and was killed after a struggle.
translations.idiomatic: In Eastern Wei, ninth month of the third year of Wuding, a leopard entered Ye's southern gate and was killed after a struggle.

sentences.zh: 五年八月，豹又上銅爵台。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year, a leopard again climbed the Bronze Bird Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifth year, a leopard again climbed the Bronze Bird Terrace.

sentences.zh: 京房《易飛候》曰：「野獸入邑，及至朝廷若道，上官府門，有大害，君亡。

translations.literal: Jing Fang's Flying Omens of the Changes says: "When wild beasts enter a settlement and reach the court or roadway, or the gates of official offices, great harm follows and the ruler perishes.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang's Flying Omens of the Changes says: "When wild beasts enter a settlement and reach the court or roadway, or the gates of official offices, great harm follows and the ruler perishes.

sentences.zh: 」是歲，東魏師敗於玉壁，神武遇疾崩。

translations.literal: " That year Eastern Wei troops were defeated at Yubi; Shenwu fell ill and died.
translations.idiomatic: " That year Eastern Wei troops were defeated at Yubi; Shenwu fell ill and died.

sentences.zh: 後齊，有兔出廟社之中。

translations.literal: Under Later Qi, a rabbit appeared from within the temple of the soil god.
translations.idiomatic: Under Later Qi, a rabbit appeared from within the temple of the soil god.

sentences.zh: 京房《易飛候》曰：「兔入王室，其君亡。

translations.literal: Jing Fang's Flying Omens of the Changes says: "When a rabbit enters the royal chamber, its ruler perishes.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang's Flying Omens of the Changes says: "When a rabbit enters the royal chamber, its ruler perishes.

sentences.zh: 」案廟者，祖宗之神室也。

translations.literal: " The temple is the spirit chamber of the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: " The temple is the spirit chamber of the ancestors.

sentences.zh: 後五歲，周師入鄴，後主東奔。

translations.literal: Five years later Zhou troops entered Ye; Houzhu fled east.
translations.idiomatic: Five years later Zhou troops entered Ye; Houzhu fled east.

sentences.zh: 武平末，並、肆諸州多狼而食人。

translations.literal: At the end of Wuping, in Bing, Si, and other provinces many wolves ate people.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Wuping, in Bing, Si, and other provinces many wolves ate people.

sentences.zh: 《洪範五行傳》曰：「狼，貪暴之獸，大體以白色為主，兵之表也。

translations.literal: The Great Plan's Transmission on the Five Phases says: "The wolf is a greedy and violent beast; its main color is white—it is the symbol of warfare.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Plan's Transmission on the Five Phases says: "The wolf is a greedy and violent beast; its main color is white—it is the symbol of warfare.

sentences.zh: 又似犬，近犬禍也。

translations.literal: It also resembles the dog—close to dog calamity.
translations.idiomatic: It also resembles the dog—close to dog calamity.

sentences.zh: 」京房《易傳》曰：「君將無道，害將及人，去之深山以全身。

translations.literal: " Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "When the ruler is about to lose the Way and harm is about to reach the people, they flee to deep mountains to preserve themselves.
translations.idiomatic: " Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes says: "When the ruler is about to lose the Way and harm is about to reach the people, they flee to deep mountains to preserve themselves.

sentences.zh: 厥妖狼食人。

translations.literal: The anomaly is wolves eating people.
translations.idiomatic: The anomaly is wolves eating people.

sentences.zh: 」時帝任用小人，竟為貪暴，殘賊人物，食人之應。

translations.literal: " At that time the emperor employed petty men, who were ultimately greedy and violent, cruelly harming people—this was the response to eating people.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time the emperor employed petty men, who were ultimately greedy and violent, cruelly harming people—this was the omen corresponding to eating people.

sentences.zh: 尋為周軍所滅，兵之象也。

translations.literal: Soon they were destroyed by Zhou troops—the symbol of warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they were destroyed by Zhou troops—the symbol of warfare.

sentences.zh: 武平中，朔州府門外，無何有小兒腳跡，又擁土為城雉之狀。

translations.literal: During Wuping, outside the gate of Shuozhou prefecture, small footprints suddenly appeared; earth was piled up in the shape of city ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: During Wuping, outside the gate of Shuozhou prefecture, small footprints suddenly appeared; earth was piled up in the shape of city ramparts.

sentences.zh: 時人怪而察之，乃狐媚所為，漸流至並、鄴。

translations.literal: People found it strange and investigated—it was the work of fox spirits; the phenomenon gradually spread to Bing and Ye.
translations.idiomatic: People found it strange and investigated—it was the work of fox spirits; the phenomenon gradually spread to Bing and Ye.

sentences.zh: 與同占。

translations.literal: Same divination.
translations.idiomatic: Same divination.

sentences.zh: 是歲，南安王思好起兵於北朔，直指并州，為官軍所敗。

translations.literal: That year Prince Nan'an Sihao raised troops in Northern Shuo, marching directly on Bing Province, and was defeated by the government army.
translations.idiomatic: That year Prince Nan'an Sihao raised troops in Northern Shuo, marching directly on Bing Province, and was defeated by the government army.

sentences.zh: 鄭子饒、羊法皓等複亂山東。

translations.literal: Zheng Zirao, Yang Fahao, and others again troubled Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zirao, Yang Fahao, and others again troubled Shandong.

sentences.zh: ○犬禍

translations.literal: ○ Dog calamities
translations.idiomatic: ○ Dog calamities

sentences.zh: 後齊，鄴中及頓丘並有犬與女子交。

translations.literal: Under Later Qi, in Ye and Dunqiu, dogs mated with women.
translations.idiomatic: Under Later Qi, in Ye and Dunqiu, dogs mated with women.

sentences.zh: 《洪範五行傳》曰：「異類不當交而交，悖亂之氣。

translations.literal: The Great Plan's Transmission on the Five Phases says: "When unlike kinds that should not mate do mate, this is perverse and disordered qi.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Plan's Transmission on the Five Phases says: "When unlike kinds that should not mate do mate, this is perverse and disordered qi.

sentences.zh: 犬交人為犬禍。

translations.literal: Dogs mating with humans is dog calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Dogs mating with humans is dog calamity.

sentences.zh: 」犬禍者，亢陽失眾之應也。

translations.literal: Dog calamity is the response to excessive yang and loss of the people.
translations.idiomatic: Dog calamity is the omen corresponding to excessive yang and loss of the people.

sentences.zh: 時帝不恤國政，恩澤不流于其國。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor did not care for state affairs; grace did not flow through his realm.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor did not care for state affairs; grace did not flow through his realm.

sentences.zh: 後主時，犬為開府儀同，雌者有夫人郡君之號，給兵以奉養，食以粱肉，藉以茵蓐。

translations.literal: Under Houzhu, dogs were given the rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness; females were given the titles of Lady and Commandery Lady, provided soldiers for their upkeep, fed fine grain and meat, and given mats and coverlets.
translations.idiomatic: Under Houzhu, dogs were given the rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness; females were given the titles of Lady and Commandery Lady, provided soldiers for their upkeep, fed fine grain and meat, and given mats and coverlets.

sentences.zh: 天奪其心，爵加於犬，近犬禍也。

translations.literal: Heaven took away his heart; ranks were bestowed on dogs—this approximates dog calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven took away his heart; ranks were bestowed on dogs—this approximates dog calamity.

sentences.zh: 天意若曰，卿士皆類犬。

translations.literal: Heaven's intent seemed to say: ministers and officers are all like dogs.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's intent seemed to say: ministers and officers are all like dogs.

sentences.zh: 後主不悟，遂以取滅。

translations.literal: Houzhu did not understand and therefore brought destruction upon himself.
translations.idiomatic: Houzhu did not heed the warnings and therefore brought destruction upon himself.

sentences.zh: 後周，有犬生子，腰已後分為兩身，二尾六足。

translations.literal: Under Later Zhou, a dog gave birth; from the waist backward the body divided into two, with two tails and six legs.
translations.idiomatic: Under Later Zhou, a dog gave birth; from the waist backward the body divided into two, with two tails and six legs.

sentences.zh: 犬猛畜而有爪牙，將士之象也。

translations.literal: The dog is a fierce beast with claws and teeth—the symbol of officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The dog is a fierce beast with claws and teeth—the symbol of officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 時宇文護與侯伏、侯龍恩等，有謀懷貳。

translations.literal: At that time Yuwen Hu, together with Hou Fu, Hou Long'en, and others, harbored disloyal plots.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Yuwen Hu, together with Hou Fu, Hou Long'en, and others, harbored disloyal plots.

sentences.zh: 犬體後分，此其應也。

translations.literal: The dog's body dividing in the rear—this was the response.
translations.idiomatic: The dog's body dividing in the rear—this was the corresponding omen.

sentences.zh: ，雁門百姓間犬多去其主，群聚於野，形頓變如狼而啖噬行人，數年而止。

translations.literal: Among the common people of Yanmen, many dogs abandoned their masters and gathered in the wild; their forms suddenly changed like wolves and they devoured travelers; this continued for several years before stopping.
translations.idiomatic: Among the common people of Yanmen, many dogs abandoned their masters and gathered in the wild; their forms suddenly changed like wolves and they devoured travelers; this continued for several years before stopping.

sentences.zh: 《五行傳》曰：「犬，守禦者也，而今去其主，臣下不附之象。

translations.literal: The Transmission on the Five Phases says: "The dog is a guardian and defender—yet now it abandons its master; this is the symbol of ministers and subordinates not attaching themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The Transmission on the Five Phases says: "The dog is a guardian and defender—yet now it abandons its master; this is the symbol of ministers and subordinates not attaching themselves.

sentences.zh: 形變如狼，狼色白，為主兵之應也。

translations.literal: The form changing like a wolf—wolves are white in color—this is the response to the ruler commanding warfare.
translations.idiomatic: The form changing like a wolf—wolves are white in color—this is the omen corresponding to the ruler commanding warfare.

sentences.zh: 」其後帝窮兵黷武，勞役不息。

translations.literal: " Afterward the emperor exhausted the people with warfare; forced labor never ceased.
translations.idiomatic: " Afterward the emperor exhausted the people with warfare; forced labor never ceased.

sentences.zh: 天戒若曰，無為勞役，守禦之臣將叛而為害。

translations.literal: Heaven's warning seemed to say: do not impose forced labor—guardian ministers will rebel and bring harm.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's warning seemed to say: do not impose forced labor—guardian ministers will rebel and bring harm.

sentences.zh: 帝不悟，遂起長城之役。

translations.literal: The emperor did not understand and therefore launched the Great Wall project.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not heed the warning and therefore launched the Great Wall project.

sentences.zh: 續有西域、遼東之舉，天下怨叛。

translations.literal: There followed campaigns in the Western Regions and Liaodong; all under Heaven resented and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: There followed campaigns in the Western Regions and Liaodong; all under Heaven resented and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 及江都之變，並宿衛之臣也。

translations.literal: At the Jiangdu incident, those involved were all palace guard ministers.
translations.idiomatic: At the Jiangdu incident, those involved were all palace guard ministers.

sentences.zh: ○白眚白祥

translations.literal: ○ White baleful signs and white omens
translations.idiomatic: ○ White baleful signs and white omens

sentences.zh: 梁，地生白毛，長二尺，近白祥也。

translations.literal: In Liang, white hair grew from the ground, two feet long—this approximates a white omen.
translations.idiomatic: In Liang, white hair grew from the ground, two feet long—this approximates a white omen.

sentences.zh: 孫盛以為勞人之異。

translations.literal: Sun Sheng considered this an anomaly of overworking the people.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Sheng considered this an anomaly of overworking the people.

sentences.zh: 先是大發卒築浮山堰，功費钜億，功垂就而複潰者，數矣。

translations.literal: Earlier corvée laborers had been massively conscripted to build the Floating Mountain Dam; the cost reached hundreds of millions; when the work was nearly complete it collapsed again—several times.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier corvée laborers had been massively conscripted to build the Floating Mountain Dam; the cost reached hundreds of millions; when the work was nearly complete it collapsed again—several times.

sentences.zh: 百姓厭役，籲嗟滿道。

translations.literal: The common people were weary of service; cries of lament filled the roads.
translations.idiomatic: The common people were weary of service; cries of lament filled the roads.

sentences.zh: 齊九月，滄州及長城之下，地多生毛，或白或黑，長四五寸，近白祥也。

translations.literal: In Qi, in the ninth month, below Cangzhou and the Great Wall, much hair grew from the ground, white or black, four or five inches long—this approximates a white omen.
translations.idiomatic: In Qi, in the ninth month, below Cangzhou and the Great Wall, much hair grew from the ground, white or black, four or five inches long—this approximates a white omen.

sentences.zh: 時北築長城，內興三台，人苦勞役。

translations.literal: At that time the Great Wall was being built in the north and the three towers were being erected within; the people suffered from forced labor.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Great Wall was being built in the north and the three towers were being erected within; the people suffered from forced labor.

sentences.zh: 七月，京師雨毛，如發尾，長者三尺余，短者六七寸。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, hair rained in the capital like the tail of hair, the long ones more than three feet, the short ones six or seven inches.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, hair rained in the capital like the tail of hair, the long ones more than three feet, the short ones six or seven inches.

sentences.zh: 京房《易飛候》曰：「天雨毛，其國大饑。

translations.literal: Jing Fang's Flying Omens of the Changes says: "When hair rains from Heaven, the state will suffer great famine.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang's Flying Omens of the Changes says: "When hair rains from Heaven, the state will suffer great famine.

sentences.zh: 」是時關中旱，米粟湧貴。

translations.literal: " At that time Guanzhong suffered drought; rice and grain surged in price.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time Guanzhong suffered drought; rice and grain surged in price.

sentences.zh: 後齊天統初，岱山封禪壇玉璧自出，近白祥也。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiantong under Later Qi, a jade bi emerged by itself from the fengshan altar at Mount Dai—this approximates a white omen.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tiantong under Later Qi, a jade bi emerged by itself from the fengshan altar at Mount Dai—this approximates a white omen.

sentences.zh: 岱山，王者易姓告代之所，玉璧所用幣而自出，將有易姓者用幣之象。

translations.literal: Mount Dai is where a new ruler announces the change of surname; the jade bi is the offering used in ritual—its emerging by itself is the symbol of one who will change the surname using the offering.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Dai is where a new ruler announces the change of surname; the jade bi is the offering used in ritual—its emerging by itself is the symbol of one who will change the surname using the offering.

sentences.zh: 其後齊亡，地入于周，及高祖受周禪，天下一統，焚柴太山告祠之應也。

translations.literal: Afterward Qi perished and its territory passed to Zhou; the High Emperor received the Zhou abdication; the realm was unified; burning firewood at Mount Tai to announce sacrifice—this was the response.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Qi perished and its territory passed to Zhou; the High Emperor received the Zhou abdication; the realm was unified; burning firewood at Mount Tai to announce sacrifice—this was the corresponding omen.

sentences.zh: ，白水岩下青石壁傍，有文曰：「齊亡走。

translations.literal: Below the White Water Cliff, beside the green stone wall, there was an inscription reading: "Qi perishes and flees.
translations.idiomatic: Below the White Water Cliff, beside the green stone wall, there was an inscription reading: "Qi perishes and flees.

sentences.zh: 」人改之為「上延」，後主以為嘉瑞，百僚畢賀。

translations.literal: " People altered it to read "Heaven extends"; Houzhu considered this an auspicious portent and all officials congratulated him.
translations.idiomatic: " People altered it to read "Heaven extends"; Houzhu considered this an auspicious portent and all officials congratulated him.

sentences.zh: 後周師入國，後主果棄鄴而走。

translations.literal: Zhou troops entered the state; Houzhu indeed abandoned Ye and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou troops entered the state; Houzhu indeed abandoned Ye and fled.

sentences.zh: ，石隕于武安、滏陽間十餘。

translations.literal: More than ten stones fell between Wu'an and Fuyang.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten stones fell between Wu'an and Fuyang.

sentences.zh: 《洪範五行傳》曰：「石自高隕者，君將有危殆也。

translations.literal: The Great Plan's Transmission on the Five Phases says: "When stones fall from on high, the ruler will face peril.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Plan's Transmission on the Five Phases says: "When stones fall from on high, the ruler will face peril.

sentences.zh: 」後七載，帝崩。

translations.literal: " Seven years later the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: " Seven years later the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 開皇末，高祖于宮中埋二小石於地，以志置床之所。

translations.literal: At the end of Kaihuang, the High Emperor buried two small stones in the ground within the palace to mark where the bed would be placed.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Kaihuang, the High Emperor buried two small stones in the ground within the palace to mark where the bed would be placed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，變為玉。

translations.literal: Before long they transformed into jade.
translations.idiomatic: Before long they transformed into jade.

sentences.zh: 劉向曰：「玉者至貴也。

translations.literal: Liu Xiang said: "Jade is the utmost of value.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiang said: "Jade is the utmost of value.

sentences.zh: 賤將為貴之象。

translations.literal: The lowly becoming exalted is the symbol.
translations.idiomatic: The lowly becoming exalted is the symbol.

sentences.zh: 」及大業末，盜皆僭名號。

translations.literal: " By the end of Daye, bandits all presumptuously assumed titles.
translations.idiomatic: " By the end of Daye, bandits all presumptuously assumed titles.

sentences.zh: ，西平郡有石，文曰：「天子立千年。

translations.literal: In Xiping Commandery there was a stone inscribed: "The Son of Heaven established for a thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiping Commandery there was a stone inscribed: "The Son of Heaven established for a thousand years.

sentences.zh: 」百僚稱賀。

translations.literal: " All officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: " All officials offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 有識者尤之曰：「千年萬歲者，身後之意也。

translations.literal: Those with insight especially objected, saying: "A thousand years, ten thousand years—these refer to what comes after death.
translations.idiomatic: Those with insight especially objected, saying: "A thousand years, ten thousand years—these refer to what comes after death.

sentences.zh: 今稱立千年者，禍在非遠。

translations.literal: Now to speak of being established for a thousand years—calamity is not far off.
translations.idiomatic: Now to speak of being established for a thousand years—calamity is not far off.

sentences.zh: 」明年而帝被殺。

translations.literal: " The next year the emperor was killed.
translations.idiomatic: " The next year the emperor was killed.

sentences.zh: ○木沴金

translations.literal: ○ Wood harming metal
translations.idiomatic: ○ Wood harming metal

sentences.zh: 梁大同十二年，曲阿建陵隧口石麒麟動。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Datong in Liang, the stone qilin at the tunnel mouth of Jianling at Qu'a moved.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Datong in Liang, the stone qilin at the tunnel mouth of Jianling at Qu'a moved.

sentences.zh: 木沴金也。

translations.literal: Wood was harming metal.
translations.idiomatic: Wood was harming metal.

sentences.zh: 動者，遷移之象。

translations.literal: Movement is the symbol of relocation.
translations.idiomatic: Movement is the symbol of relocation.

sentences.zh: 天戒若曰，園陵無主，石麟將為人所徙也。

translations.literal: Heaven's warning seemed to say: the imperial park and tombs have no master—the stone qilin will be moved by others.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's warning seemed to say: the imperial park and tombs have no master—the stone qilin will be moved by others.

sentences.zh: 後竟國亡。

translations.literal: Afterward the state was indeed destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the state was indeed destroyed.

sentences.zh: 後齊，殿上石自起，兩兩相擊。

translations.literal: Under Later Qi, stones in the hall rose by themselves and struck one another in pairs.
translations.idiomatic: Under Later Qi, stones in the hall rose by themselves and struck one another in pairs.

sentences.zh: 眭孟以為石陰類，下人象，殿上石自起者，左右親人離叛之應。

translations.literal: Suimeng considered stone a yin category and the symbol of subordinates; stones in the hall rising by themselves was the response to close kin on left and right splitting and rebelling.
translations.idiomatic: Suimeng considered stone a yin category and the symbol of subordinates; stones in the hall rising by themselves was the omen corresponding to close kin on left and right splitting and rebelling.

sentences.zh: 及周師東伐，寵臣尉相願、乞扶貴和兄弟、韓建業之徒，皆叛入周。

translations.literal: When Zhou troops campaigned eastward, favored ministers Wei Xiangyuan, Qi Fuguihe and his brother, Han Jianye, and others all rebelled and entered Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou troops campaigned eastward, favored ministers Wei Xiangyuan, Qi Fuguihe and his brother, Han Jianye, and others all rebelled and entered Zhou.

sentences.zh: 梁正月，送辟邪二於建陵。

translations.literal: In Liang, in the first month, two ward-off-evil statues were sent to Jianling.
translations.idiomatic: In Liang, in the first month, two ward-off-evil statues were sent to Jianling.

sentences.zh: 左雙角者至陵所。

translations.literal: The left one with double horns reached the tomb site.
translations.idiomatic: The left one with double horns reached the tomb site.

sentences.zh: 右獨角者，將引，于車上振躍者三。

translations.literal: The right one with a single horn, as it was about to be led, leaped and stamped three times on the cart.
translations.idiomatic: The right one with a single horn, as it was about to be led, leaped and stamped three times on the cart.

sentences.zh: 車兩轅俱折。

translations.literal: Both cart shafts broke.
translations.idiomatic: Both cart shafts broke.

sentences.zh: 因換車。

translations.literal: They therefore changed carts.
translations.idiomatic: They therefore changed carts.

sentences.zh: 未至陵二裡，又躍者三，每一振則車側人莫不聳奮，去地三四尺，車輪陷入土三寸。

translations.literal: Before reaching the tomb by two li, it leaped three times again; with each stamp the people beside the cart all started and trembled, rising three or four feet from the ground; the cart wheels sank three inches into the earth.
translations.idiomatic: Before reaching the tomb by two li, it leaped three times again; with each stamp the people beside the cart all started and trembled, rising three or four feet from the ground; the cart wheels sank three inches into the earth.

sentences.zh: 木暕金也。

translations.literal: Wood was harming metal.
translations.idiomatic: Wood was harming metal.

sentences.zh: 劉向曰：「失眾心，令不行，言不從，以亂金氣也。

translations.literal: Liu Xiang said: "Losing the people's hearts, orders are not executed, words are not followed—this disorders the qi of metal.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiang said: "Losing the people's hearts, orders are not executed, words are not followed—this disorders the qi of metal.

sentences.zh: 石為陰，臣象也。

translations.literal: Stone is yin—the symbol of ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Stone is yin—the symbol of ministers.

sentences.zh: 臣將為變之應。

translations.literal: This was the response to ministers about to undergo transformation.
translations.idiomatic: This was the omen corresponding to ministers about to undergo transformation.

sentences.zh: 」梁武暮年，不以政事為意，君臣唯講佛經、談玄而已。

translations.literal: " In his later years Emperor Wu of Liang paid no heed to government affairs; ruler and ministers discussed only Buddhist sutras and the abstruse.
translations.idiomatic: " In his later years Emperor Wu of Liang paid no heed to government affairs; ruler and ministers discussed only Buddhist sutras and the abstruse.

sentences.zh: 朝綱紊亂，令不行，言不從之咎也。

translations.literal: Court discipline was disordered—the fault of orders not executed and words not followed.
translations.idiomatic: Court discipline was disordered—the fault of orders not executed and words not followed.

sentences.zh: 其後果致侯景之亂。

translations.literal: Afterward the rebellion of Hou Jing indeed arose.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the rebellion of Hou Jing indeed arose.

sentences.zh: 周，濮陽郡有石像，郡官令載向府，將刮取金。

translations.literal: Under Zhou, in Puyang Commandery there was a stone image; the commandery officials ordered it loaded and taken to the prefectural seat, intending to scrape off the gold.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhou, in Puyang Commandery there was a stone image; the commandery officials ordered it loaded and taken to the prefectural seat, intending to scrape off the gold.

sentences.zh: 在道自躍投地，如此者再。

translations.literal: On the road it leaped by itself and threw itself to the ground—this happened twice.
translations.idiomatic: On the road it leaped by itself and threw itself to the ground—this happened twice.

sentences.zh: 乃以大繩縛著車壁，又絕繩而下。

translations.literal: They then bound it with a large rope to the cart wall, but the rope also broke and it fell down.
translations.idiomatic: They then bound it with a large rope to the cart wall, but the rope also broke and it fell down.

sentences.zh: 時帝既滅齊，又事淮南，征伐不息，百姓疲敝，失眾心之應也。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor had already destroyed Qi and was also campaigning in Huainan; warfare never ceased; the common people were exhausted—this was the response to losing the people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor had already destroyed Qi and was also campaigning in Huainan; warfare never ceased; the common people were exhausted—this was the omen corresponding to losing the people's hearts.
